title: Dad gave him 30 days; now he owns the mansion
description: Nate's dad mocks his trading and throws him out with 30 days to make it work; at rock bottom in the rain his phone starts dinging with wins on fomo. He grinds from a tiny rented room to a six-figure balance, and when his dad turns up at his mansion asking if he works there, Nate says 'Nope. I own it.'
text:
SCENE 1 — INT. NATE'S ROOM — NIGHT
Nate spins round in his gaming chair from a wall of monitors full of red charts; his dad looms over him, pointing at the screens.
NATE: Dad!
DAD: You're 30 years old, unemployed, and this is your plan?
NATE: I'm a trader!
DAD: How many did you win?
Silence. Nate's shoulders sink; his phone glows face up on the desk.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone on the desk, the line sliding red
SCENE 2 — EXT. FRONT DOOR — DUSK
Dad wrestles a black bin bag off Nate, throws it out and shoves him onto the porch.
NATE: Wait, where am I supposed to go?
DAD: Figure it out.
NATE: You're serious?
Nose to nose against the front door, extreme close-up in profile.
NATE: Give me one month.
NATE: If I can't make this work, I'll quit.
DAD: You have 30 days.
The door shuts and the porch light goes dark. Nate stands alone among his bags, then pulls out his phone.
NATE: Come on.
SCENE 3 — MONTAGE — PORCH AND FRONT LAWN — DAYS
Nate on his laptop, lit from below, jaw set.
NATE: Different.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, his first trade sliding
NATE: Nothing.
Match cuts, same pose on the front lawn: Nate holds his phone up to camera, a different token each time, every chart red.
NATE: Nothing.
NATE: Okay?
NATE: Cool.
NATE: Awesome.
Dawn: Nate asleep curled on his bin bags by the door; then hunched over the laptop again, the screen the only light.
SCENE 4 — EXT. KERB — NIGHT, RAIN
Nate and his bags are hurled out onto the wet kerb; he lands face-down in a puddle, clutching his phone.
Nate slumps against his bags in the rain, laptop on his lap, lit windows behind; slow drift in.
DAD (V.O.): You have 30 days.
NATE: Maybe he was right.
His phone buzzes. He sits up, staring at it.
NATE: Wait.
NATE: No, wait.
NATE: Yo!
Nate wipes the rain off the screen with his sleeve.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$420 (+38%)
NATE: Wait!
NATE: Wait!
His phone dings again and again, ding, ding, ding, ding, ding, as a slow push on his face speeds into a crash zoom into his pupil.
NATE: Oh, no!
In a dark garage, Nate slams the laptop open, phone in hand.
★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on Nate's laptop, every position green, the balance reads $1,950
NATE: All of it.
Nate shoves open the garage doors onto bright morning sun and plants his feet.
NATE: Let's work!
SCENE 5 — MONTAGE — TINY RENTED ROOM TO PENTHOUSE — NIGHTS
A tiny rented room under one bare bulb: Nate, cap backwards, hunched over the laptop at 3 a.m. as empty energy-drink cans stack up until they wall off the frame.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$3,400
Match cut, same pose: Nate at the laptop with a second monitor now, rain on the window, rubbing his eyes; the balance reads $7,800.
Nate spins and juggles two phones, catching them both.
NATE: Gotcha.
One phone bounces off his head.
NATE: Bro...
Match cut, same pose, bigger room: a bright loft with three monitors; a small fist pump as the balance reads $16,500.
Match cut, same pose, bigger world: another late night at a desk by a penthouse window over the city; the balance reads $38,200.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $720,000
Nate leans back from the desk, the skyline behind him, a slow smile.
SCENE 6 — EXT./INT. NATE'S MANSION — LATE AFTERNOON
Dad's old blue pickup rattles up the drive of a huge white mansion; he climbs out and squints through the tall glass front doors.
DAD: Nate? You work here?
Over Dad's shoulder, the front doors swing open on a vast marble hall, a chandelier, a pool glittering beyond.
DAD: Nate?
Deep symmetrical wide: Nate, small in the centre of the hall in a black suit, turns casually.
NATE: Nope.
NATE: I own it.
Snap zoom into Dad's face, eyes bulging.
DAD: What?
DAD: There's no way you made all this.
DAD (O.S.): How did you even make it?
Nate turns from the hall to camera with a knowing smirk.
NATE: I made this video.
NATE: Link in bio.
Nate holds up his phone to camera.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone held to camera, the balance reads $720,000
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
changed_lines: I'm a reseller! → I'm a trader!
How many did you sell? → How many did you win?

cast.description: 30 (his dad says so) but boyish, looks barely 20; slim; big glossy brown eyes, thick dark brows, dark curly hair; navy cap worn backwards, plain white tee, thin silver chain, black pants, white sneakers. At the mansion: a black suit over a black tee, no cap.
Late 50s, tall and broad caricature; huge nose and square chin, slicked-back brown hair; navy suit, light-blue shirt, navy tie. Later drives an old blue pickup. Contemptuous squint.
